cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the house meeting, support my reading of the bin rota. Alex swapped weeks with me; swaps move duties, not just names.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you only swapped the vacuuming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must distinguish an agreement from your recollection of it. Tell them we need one consistent rule for swaps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll support a rule. I won't say Alex agreed to the bins.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quite right: don't speculate about Alex. Say 'a week means a week' when I explain. Clearly, I need someone else to read the heading aloud.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers a conflicting recollection and B4 agrees only to a rule, forcing A to narrow recruitment.

heightening.evidence: A5 adapts B4 conditional cooperation into a statement that still favours A reading.
